verses.he: בְּצֵ֣את יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם בֵּ֥ית יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב מֵעַ֥ם לֹעֵֽז׃
verses.en: When Israel came forth out of Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
Judah became His sanctuary, Israel His dominion.

verses.he: הַיָּ֣ם רָ֭אָה וַיָּנֹ֑ס הַ֝יַּרְדֵּ֗ן יִסֹּ֥ב לְאָחֽוֹר׃
verses.en: The sea saw it, and fled; The Jordan turned backward.
The mountains skipped like rams, The hills like young sheep.

verses.he: מַה־לְּךָ֣ הַ֭יָּם כִּ֣י תָנ֑וּס הַ֝יַּרְדֵּ֗ן תִּסֹּ֥ב לְאָחֽוֹר׃
verses.en: What aileth thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest? Thou Jordan, that thou turnest backward?
Ye mountains, that ye skip like rams; Ye hills, like young sheep?

verses.he: מִלִּפְנֵ֣י אָ֭דוֹן ח֣וּלִי אָ֑רֶץ מִ֝לִּפְנֵ֗י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.en: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, At the presence of the God of Jacob;
Who turned the rock into a pool of water, The flint into a fountain of waters.
